scope: Native WinUI implementation of the approved Fluent redesign, with representative native UI verification and automated regressions.
nativeChecks: DPAPI-backed synthetic account unlock in Debug and Native AOT.
Initial vault state has no selected credential.
Work folder and GitHub query survive Send navigation and return without reopening details.
Protected login verification updates password, TOTP, notes, and both website addresses under Native AOT.
Existing login editor loads with original folder and masked password; cancellation leaves the app responsive.
New login editor starts empty, rejects an empty required name, and cancels without stale values or recursive binding.
Native AOT client created and encrypted a synthetic login named UI implementation check; successful save returned its detail.
Offline unlock with the tunnel stopped, followed by tunnel restoration and manual synchronization, clears offline status without another unlock.
Reused-password result expansion succeeds in Debug and Native AOT; Amazon and Reddit actions open their respective credentials.
Generator workspace displays results and successful copy feedback updates the session history.
Send list renders actual availability and retention information; creation dialog opens and cancels.
Import/export cards, device registration list, settings categories, and emergency-access return navigation render correctly.
A roughly 755-pixel-wide native window switches between list and detail views through the return action.
Lock removes the vault shell from the active UI tree; page caches and navigation metadata are cleared by the lifecycle path.
Forced dark and system light themes render, including a protected-field confirmation popup that inherits dark theme.

fixture.credentialHandling: Master password loaded from DPAPI ciphertext into memory only; no memory dumps or plaintext credential files were created.

limitations: Captures are representative native states, not exhaustive coverage of all 98 prototype scenarios.
Newer cipher types and trusted-device functionality remain gated by real backend capabilities.
External authentication enrollment, real email delivery, account deletion, and external breach checks were not exercised.
The local review build omits browser-native-host packaging; MSIX packaging and signing were outside this task.
Upstream reference assemblies emit IL3058 compatibility warnings. Native AOT compilation and the listed native flows passed.
